maddeler.e:
اغتربوا (form VIII)
# اِغْتَرَبُوا (iḡtarabū) /iɣ.ta.ra.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
# اُغْتُرِبُوا (uḡturibū) /uɣ.tu.ri.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
# اِغْتَرِبُوا (iḡtaribū) /iɣ.ta.ri.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
